areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: Steam, the Windows save folder, the journal, and the Resistance Base.
areas.note: Chosen route: native Windows PC VR through SteamVR-compatible hardware; no secondary-platform content or emulation branch applies.

items.label: Use the chosen Windows PC VR release

levels.1: Confirm the headset runtime before starting the campaign.
levels.2: Install the Steam release and launch it through a SteamVR-compatible headset.
levels.3: Install app 752480, start SteamVR first, then launch the game and verify motion controls, dominant hand, seated or standing height, and rifle alignment in the tutorial. The Quest and PlayStation VR editions add no separate campaign content to this chosen route.

levels.1: Protect the journal before grinding stars and weapon variants.
levels.2: Copy the ProgressionSaveData folder under %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Just Add Water\SniperEliteVR.
levels.3: Close the game and open %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow. Inside the developer folder named Just Add Water, copy SniperEliteVR\ProgressionSaveData to a dated folder elsewhere; retain it until the journal, arsenal wall, and mastery counters have all been audited.

levels.1: One profile can retain the whole completion record.
levels.2: Turn back to any cleared operation page and select it again when a star or collectible slot is incomplete.
levels.3: At the base, page backward through the journal, select any cleared operation, and replay it on the needed difficulty. Collectibles persist after a checkpoint or completed run, and difficulty can be changed without erasing them; verify each icon before leaving the page.

items.label: Confirm the release has no extra campaign branch

levels.1: Keep the route limited to content actually shipped for this edition.
levels.2: Use the Windows release’s campaign, base ranges, arsenal, stars, and records; no downloaded campaign or New Game Plus selector exists.
levels.3: After updating the Windows build, inspect the main journal and mode selector. Complete the tutorial/base, every available operation page, three firing ranges, arsenal wall, mastery variants, and gameplay records. Do not add Quest or PlayStation replays: current sources identify no exclusive missions, downloaded campaign, or additional completion branch.

areas.name: Walled Village Gate
areas.location_cue: A village entrance lined with stone buildings, sandbags, and a defended gate.

point_of_no_return.title: Current visit ends at the operation endpoint

items.label: Clear the walled village gate operation

levels.1: Follow the required markers, but inspect side paths before leaving.
levels.2: Complete every required objective in the walled village gate and reach its endpoint.
levels.3: Complete the required objective chain, wait for the operation-complete page, and return to the journal only after the clear has registered. The endpoint closes the current visit, but the page remains replayable.

levels.1: The middle star asks for a deliberate play style or weapon choice.
levels.2: Open this operation’s journal page and satisfy its named challenge during one run: Land one headshot from beyond 25 metres.
levels.3: Use Cadet for cleanup and land one headshot from beyond 25 metres. Finish the operation after the star appears; restarting from a checkpoint can discard challenge progress, so restart the whole operation when an attempt fails.

levels.1: Accuracy, distance, and an unbroken multiplier matter more than rushing.
levels.2: Finish with more than 1,000 points; the threshold is printed on this operation’s journal page.
levels.3: Play on Cadet, avoid misses so the multiplier survives, favour distant headshots and organ hits, and finish above 1,000 points. A score equal to the printed threshold may not satisfy wording that says ‘more than,’ so leave a margin before completing the final objective.

levels.1: Pause at each new room or overlook and scan surfaces, shelves, and distant stonework.
levels.2: Use the journal’s Collectibles column to clear every nonzero letter, scarf, and stone-eagle slot in this operation.
levels.3: NEEDS_VERIFICATION

areas.name: Campaign Records
areas.location_cue: Replayable operations, the journal ledger, and the post-operation results cards.
areas.note: These are persistent gameplay and completion records, not platform-reward framing.

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Use rifle kill-cam hits until every distinct organ entry has registered; consult the in-game record between attempts so repeated organs are not mistaken for new ones.

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Use a range with a long open lane, tag a target beyond 200 metres, compensate for drop, and confirm the distance shown after the hit.

items.label: Eliminate multiple guards by shooting TNT

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: During the lakeside-house operation, move TNT from the upper floor into an approaching group’s route, wait for at least two guards to enter its blast radius, then detonate it with a rifle round.

items.label: Finish an operation without breaking concealment

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Use Cadet for cleanup, fire only under sound cover or from a position you can abandon, and restart if any guard fully identifies you before the endpoint.

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Take a trip mine from the lakeside house’s lower floor, arm it across a narrow approach, and let a walking guard trigger it; a nearby detonation that does not use the tripwire does not count.

items.label: Stop a guard actively running for an alarm

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: At the forest-lakeside camp, expose yourself near the opening tents and alarm bell, allow a guard to begin the alarm run, then eliminate that runner before the bell is reached.

items.label: Land ten consecutive headshots without a miss

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Use Cadet and a stable short-range sequence. Any missed shot breaks the chain, so pause between targets and reload only after the current magazine is safely clear.

items.label: Land three distant Carcano eliminations in 8.3 seconds

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Equip the Carcano, choose a wave or fixed-vantage operation, line up three targets at least 81 metres away, then begin the timed sequence with the first confirmed elimination and finish the other two inside 8.3 seconds.

items.label: Make every rifle round in one magazine lethal

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: On Cadet, begin with a full rifle magazine and make every shot a confirmed elimination until the magazine is empty; reloading early, wounding without finishing, or missing invalidates the attempt.

items.label: Eliminate three guards with one explosion

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Group three active guards around one explosive source or use a Panzerfaust on a tight formation; the same blast must provide all three final hits.

items.label: Defeat a sniper with an eye hit

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Enable the detailed hit camera, steady on an exposed enemy sniper, and place the rifle round through the eye rather than merely inside the broader head-hit region.

items.label: Follow a thrown-object stagger with an immediate elimination

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Pick up a bottle or other loose prop, throw it hard enough to stagger rather than kill a guard, and fire the finishing shot before the stagger animation ends.

items.label: Use an unscoped weapon from the church vantage

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Load the church-vantage operation with an iron-sight rifle, wait for the marked distant vehicle stop, fire from the church, and deliver a second shot if the first only incapacitates; the red score confirmation must appear.

items.label: Detonate a grenade carried by a guard

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: View a guard from the side so the belt grenade is unobstructed, aim directly at the grenade, and make the explosion—not the bullet’s body damage—supply the elimination.

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Use a hard surface at a shallow angle and line the deflected trajectory through a nearby guard. Confirm the ricochet notification rather than accepting an ordinary direct hit.

items.label: Hit both testicles with one round

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Use a side-on or downed target on Cadet, align the shot through both testicles, and wait for the specific double-organ confirmation before moving on.

items.label: Survive near death during a Sniper Elite clear

levels.1: Set up the condition deliberately during cleanup.
levels.2: Use Cadet unless the condition names Sniper Elite difficulty.
levels.3: Choose the short village-gate operation on Sniper Elite, deliberately take damage until the near-death state appears, recover without dying, then finish the operation in that same attempt.

items.label: Clear the campaign on Sniper Elite difficulty

levels.1: Save this pass until the arsenal includes a quiet rifle and familiar sidearm.
levels.2: Replay every operation with Sniper Elite selected and verify the campaign difficulty record after the final clear.
levels.3: Select the built-in Sniper Elite preset before each uncleared operation, keep it active through the results page, and use cover, sound masking, healing, and checkpoints as needed. Stars and collectibles may be cleaned on Cadet separately; only the difficulty clear must remain on Sniper Elite.

items.label: Verify every operation has all three stars

levels.1: The journal is the authoritative completion ledger.
levels.2: Turn through every operation page and confirm its completion, special-challenge, and score stars are filled.
levels.3: At Partisan HQ, inspect each replayable operation page. A full page needs the completion star, its operation-specific challenge star, and its score-threshold star. Replay only the missing condition; cumulative stars open later pages, but true completion requires every page to show all three.

items.label: Verify every collectible slot is filled

levels.1: Do not rely on memory after a pickup-heavy replay.
levels.2: Inspect the collectible column on every operation page and clear each nonzero counter.
levels.3: Turn through the journal after all collectible runs. Letters and partisan scarves register when picked up; stone eagles register when destroyed. A pickup must survive to a checkpoint or completed operation. Replay any page with an incomplete numerator until the complete-census record appears.
